provenance.source: flyvis 1.2.0 (pip), released pretrained ensemble flow/0000, Lappalainen et al. 2024 Nature 634:1132
provenance.download: flyvis download-pretrained (package's public Google Drive distribution; SHA256 checksums verified by the downloader: results_pretrained_models.zip 71c78d40..., results_umap_and_clustering.zip 6300ec1e...)
provenance.checkpoint: chkpts/chkpt_00000 per model (sole released checkpoint; verified identical to what NetworkView.init_network() recovers)

task_optimal_subset.definition: cluster 0 of Ensemble.cluster_indices('T4c') on the RELEASED precomputed UMAP+GMM clustering; flyvis relabels clusters by ascending task error, so cluster 0 is the paper's task-optimal T4c-tuning cluster (Lappalainen 2024 Fig. 4)
task_optimal_subset.caveat: sklearn emitted InconsistentVersionWarning unpickling the stored clustering (built with 1.1.1, read with the installed version); labels and mask are stored values, not refit, and the ensemble-consistency check in cluster_indices passed

provenance.aggregation: arithmetic mean (and std) over models of raw checkpoint values; alpha clamped >=0 per model before averaging (flyvis clamps at use); negative raw alphas encountered: 0
provenance.alpha_semantics: weight_ij = sign_pair * syn_count_ij * alpha_pair (VERIFIED, flyvis/network/dynamics.py PPNeuronIGRSynapses.write_derived_params); alpha is the per-type-pair unitary strength multiplying the synapse count, units a.u. per synapse; flyvis init was rho/<N>_pair, rho=0.01 (VERIFIED, flyvis/network/initialization.py SynapseCountScaling)
provenance.units: tau in ms (checkpoint stores seconds); v_rest and alpha in flyvis a.u.
